title: contractRevisions
responsibility: Resolves user revision selectors to commit ids and chooses default, staged, range, since or first-parent commit comparison snapshots without invoking a shell.

inputs.name: resolveContractRevision.git
inputs.description: Repository-bound Git adapter; revision tokens are passed as argument data with end-of-options protection and are resolved on each query.

inputs.name: resolveContractRevision.revision
inputs.description: User-supplied existing commit reference; empty, leading-option, control-character or unresolved inputs are rejected.

inputs.name: contractComparison.git
inputs.description: Repository-bound Git adapter; revision tokens are passed as argument data with end-of-options protection and are resolved on each query.

inputs.name: contractComparison.revisions
inputs.description: Zero selectors for HEAD to working tree, one range or commit selector, or two explicit revisions; a lone commit compares its first parent or the empty root base.

inputs.name: contractComparison.options
inputs.description: Project root, identity/path/kind/area and field filters, snapshot selectors, output mode and limits. Diff counts precede display limits; log limits matching commits.

inputs.name: firstContractParent.git
inputs.description: Repository-bound Git adapter; revision tokens are passed as argument data with end-of-options protection and are resolved on each query.

inputs.name: firstContractParent.commit
inputs.description: Resolved commit object id whose first parent is requested; a root commit returns the empty snapshot marker.

outputs.name: resolveContractRevision
outputs.description: Full commit object id returned by Git, resolved afresh even when the input ref resembles a hash.

outputs.name: contractComparison
outputs.description: Ordered base and head snapshot markers: resolved commits, working-tree, index or empty; root commits use empty as their base.

outputs.name: firstContractParent
outputs.description: First parent commit object id, or the empty marker for a root commit.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Invalid, missing or incompatible revision selectors, including missing HEAD; malformed ranges and option-like refs are rejected.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Repository Git operations can fail; their stderr diagnostic propagates without invoking a shell.
